title: Luke Skywalker
description: Living with his aunt and uncle on their moisture farm, Luke Skywalker was left on Tatooine by Obi-Wan Kenobi to protect him from the Sith. When his aunt and uncle were killed, Luke opted to leave Tatooine behind for good, learning the ways of the Force from Obi-Wan Kenobi and becoming a Jedi like his father. Racing to save Princess Leia Organa, Luke joined the Rebel Alliance, flew an X-wing as part of Red Squadron, and destroyed the Empire's ultimate superweapon, the Death Star— but he still had much more to learn.
